title: George Ellery Hale's inspiring elf or spirit

tellings.quote: Hale claimed he received creative inspiration from a being, an elf or a spirit, as he described it.

plain: The astronomer George Ellery Hale said he got creative ideas from a being he described as an elf or a spirit, according to Jesse Michels. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about NASA and the hidden side of science. It would mean some of science's great work was inspired by something beyond the human mind.
